send_email.description: Send a plain text or HTML email through Yahoo Mail.
send_email.name: send_email

parameters.description: Who to send the email to. To reach more than one person, separate the addresses with commas.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: The subject line of the email.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: The plain text content of the email.
parameters.name: body_text

parameters.description: People to copy on the email. Separate multiple addresses with commas.
parameters.name: cc

parameters.description: People to copy privately. Other recipients will not see these addresses. Separate multiple addresses with commas.
parameters.name: bcc

recipients.description: All recipient addresses the email was sent to (To, Cc, and Bcc).

sent.description: Indicates whether the email was successfully sent. True means the message was handed off to Yahoo for delivery.

description: Send emails from your Yahoo Mail account.
